Extremely satisfying to watch

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-27T16:44:06+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2126356401568231871; média: videó, 53 másodperc]
Perplexity made this domino art scene with code only - no 3D software, physics library, reference assets, or generative media models.

It wrote a C++ path tracer that uses Embree for ray intersection, a rigid-body solver that advances 10,930 dominoes in steps of 1/4,800 of a second, and a modal synthesizer that computes the sound of 76,826 collisions from the solver's contact log.

All 1,590 frames were rendered at 1080p across 60 parallel sandboxes.
